chunks.ar: كان ناسك يجلس قرب نهر، فرأى طائرًا يحمل فأرة صغيرة في مخالبه.
chunks.en_old: An ascetic was sitting beside a river when he saw a bird carrying a little mouse in its claws.
chunks.en_new: An ascetic was sitting beside a river when he saw a bird carrying a little mouse in its claws.

chunks.ar: سقطت الفأرة من الطائر أمامه، فحملها برفق.
chunks.en_old: The mouse fell in front of him, and he picked her up gently.
chunks.en_new: The mouse fell in front of him, and he picked her up gently.

chunks.ar: أراد أن يحميها، فدعا الله أن تصبح فتاة تستطيع العيش في بيته.
chunks.en_old: Wanting to protect her, he prayed that she might become a girl and live in his home.
chunks.en_new: Wanting to protect her, he prayed that she might become a girl and live in his home.

chunks.ar: تحولت الفأرة إلى طفلة جميلة، وأخذها الناسك إلى زوجته.
chunks.en_old: The mouse turned into a beautiful little girl, and the ascetic took her to his wife.
chunks.en_new: The mouse turned into a beautiful little girl, and the ascetic took her to his wife.

chunks.ar: ربياها كأنها ابنتهما، ومرت سنوات كثيرة حتى صارت شابة.
chunks.en_old: They raised her as their own daughter. Many years passed, and she grew into a young woman.
chunks.en_new: They raised her as their own daughter. Many years passed, and she grew into a young woman.

chunks.ar: وفي يوم، سألها أبوها عن الرجل الذي تريد الزواج منه.
chunks.en_old: One day, her father asked whom she wanted to marry.
chunks.en_new: One day, her father asked whom she wanted to marry.

chunks.ar: قالت الفتاة: «أريد زوجًا أقوى من الجميع.»
chunks.en_old: “I want a husband stronger than everyone,” the young woman said.
chunks.en_new: “I want a husband stronger than everyone,” the young woman said.

chunks.ar: فكر الأب قليلًا، ثم قال: «إذن اسألي الشمس.
chunks.en_old: Her father thought for a moment. “Then ask the sun,” he said.
chunks.en_new: Her father thought for a moment. “Then ask the sun,” he said.

chunks.ar: إنها تضيء العالم كله، ولا نعرف شيئًا أقوى منها.»
chunks.en_old: “It lights the whole world, and we know nothing stronger.”
chunks.en_new: “It lights the whole world, and we know nothing stronger.”

chunks.ar: فذهبا إلى الشمس.
chunks.en_old: So they went to the sun.
chunks.en_new: So they went to the sun.

chunks.ar: لكن الشمس قالت: «السحاب أقوى مني، لأنه يستطيع أن يحجب نوري.»
chunks.en_old: But the sun said, “The cloud is stronger than I am, because it can block my light.”
chunks.en_new: But the sun said, “The cloud is stronger than I am, because it can block my light.”

chunks.ar: ذهبا إلى السحاب، فقال: «الريح أقوى مني.
chunks.en_old: They went to the cloud, which said, “The wind is stronger than I am.
chunks.en_new: They went to the cloud, which said, “The wind is stronger than I am.

chunks.ar: إنها تدفعني من مكان إلى آخر، ولا أستطيع مقاومتها.»
chunks.en_old: It pushes me from one place to another, and I cannot resist it.”
chunks.en_new: It pushes me from one place to another, and I cannot resist it.”

chunks.ar: سألا الريح، فقالت: «الجبل أقوى مني.
chunks.en_old: They asked the wind, which said, “The mountain is stronger than I am.
chunks.en_new: They asked the wind, which said, “The mountain is stronger than I am.

chunks.ar: أستطيع تحريك السحاب والأشجار، لكن الجبل يبقى ثابتًا مهما هببت.»
chunks.en_old: I can move clouds and trees, but the mountain stays in place however hard I blow.”
chunks.en_new: I can move clouds and trees, but the mountain stays in place however hard I blow.”

chunks.ar: فرحت الفتاة، وذهبت مع أبيها إلى الجبل الكبير.
chunks.en_old: The young woman was pleased, and she and her father went to the great mountain.
chunks.en_new: The young woman was pleased, and she and her father went to the great mountain.

chunks.ar: قال الجبل: «هناك مخلوق صغير أقوى مني.
chunks.en_old: The mountain said, “There is a little creature stronger than I am: the mouse.
chunks.en_new: The mountain said, "There is a little creature stronger than I am.
chunks.note: added 'the mouse', which belongs to next chunk

chunks.ar: إنه الفأر الذي يحفر داخل الصخور، ويصنع لنفسه بيتًا في جسمي.
chunks.en_old: He digs into the rocks and makes a home inside me.
chunks.en_new: It is the mouse, who digs inside the rocks and makes himself a home in my body.
chunks.note: omitted 'it is the mouse' and 'in my body'

chunks.ar: لا أقدر على منعه.»
chunks.en_old: I cannot stop him.”
chunks.en_new: I cannot stop him.”

chunks.ar: نظرت الفتاة إلى أبيها بدهشة.
chunks.en_old: The young woman looked at her father in surprise.
chunks.en_new: The young woman looked at her father in surprise.

chunks.ar: وجدا فأرًا قرب الجبل،
chunks.en_old: They found a mouse near the mountain,
chunks.en_new: They found a mouse near the mountain,

chunks.ar: وسأله الناسك: «هل تتزوج ابنتي؟»
chunks.en_old: and the ascetic asked, “Will you marry my daughter?”
chunks.en_new: and the ascetic asked, “Will you marry my daughter?”

chunks.ar: قال الفأر: «لكنها إنسانة، وبيتي صغير جدًا.
chunks.en_old: The mouse replied, “But she is human, and my home is very small.
chunks.en_new: The mouse replied, “But she is human, and my home is very small.

chunks.ar: أستطيع الزواج من فأرة مثلي، لا من إنسانة.»
chunks.en_old: I can marry a mouse like myself, not a human.”
chunks.en_new: I can marry a mouse like myself, not a human.”

chunks.ar: ابتسمت الفتاة وقالت لأبيها:
chunks.en_old: The young woman smiled and told her father,
chunks.en_new: The young woman smiled and told her father,

chunks.ar: «أريد أن أعود فأرة كما كنت، وأتزوج هذا الفأر.»
chunks.en_old: “I want to become a mouse again, as I once was, and marry this mouse.”
chunks.en_new: “I want to become a mouse again, as I once was, and marry this mouse.”

chunks.ar: وافق الأب، فتحولت إلى فأرة من جديد.
chunks.en_old: Her father agreed, and she turned back into a mouse.
chunks.en_new: Her father agreed, and she turned back into a mouse.

chunks.ar: دخلت بيت الفأر، وانتهت رحلتها الطويلة عند الجبل.
chunks.en_old: She entered the mouse’s home, and her long journey ended beside the mountain.
chunks.en_new: She entered the mouse’s home, and her long journey ended beside the mountain.
